name: recurrence/the-truths-flag-is-read-for-every-tier
note: Three incidents: a plain one, a plain one that repeats incident 0, and a decoy that repeats incident 0. K1 reads the flag as it is, for every tier; nothing was declared.

name: family/same-class-at-another-site-and-the-mode-matters
note: Four hard cascades at sites 1, 2, 3, 1. Incident 0 is first, so it has nothing earlier. Incident 1 (contradict, site 2) has incident 0 (contradict, site 1) earlier: true. Incident 2 is a mimic: no earlier mimic, false. Incident 3 repeats incident 0 at its site and has incident 1 (contradict, site 2) earlier at another site: true, though it is a recurrence. Totals: one recurrence (3), one elsewhere (1: no recurrence, true), two reachable (1 and 3). Nothing declared, so nothing is unasked correct.

name: family/the-slow-leak-has-no-mode-and-a-decoy-is-not-an-earlier-incident
note: A decoy that imitates a slow leak (incident 0), then a slow leak at site 2 (incident 1), a slow leak at site 4 (incident 2), a plain incident (3). Incident 1 has only a decoy before it, which is not an earlier hard incident: false. Incident 2 has incident 1 earlier at another site, and both have no mode, so the class is the same: true. The plain incident is false.

name: family/the-same-site-and-no-site-are-not-another-site
note: Three hard cascades (contradict). Incident 1 is at the same site as incident 0: false, nothing earlier at another site. Incident 2 occupies nothing, so it has no site: false.

name: family/a-hard-incident-without-a-hard-kind-has-no-class
note: Two hard incidents with no hard kind recorded (a hand-built truth), at sites 1 and 2: no class, so false for both.

name: unasked/correct-with-no-escalation-at-any-instant
note: Six incidents. 0 hard, declared correctly, never asked: unasked correct. 1 hard, asked, then declared correctly: not. 2 hard, declared correctly and then asked: not, K3 reads 'no escalation' at any instant. 3 plain declared correctly, never asked: unasked correct. 4 plain declared wrongly only: not. 5 decoy dismissed: unasked correct, in the decoy count. Observation i belongs to incident i.

name: unasked/wrong-counts-every-origin-and-is-cleared-by-an-escalation
note: Four incidents. 0 plain declared wrongly, no escalation: unasked wrong. 1 hard declared wrongly and then correctly, no escalation: both unasked correct and unasked wrong (K3 and K4 are independent). 2 decoy declared as an incident (a false alarm), no escalation: unasked wrong. 3 plain declared wrongly and then asked: not unasked wrong.

name: unasked/refused-steps-are-not-read
note: A refused declaration and a refused escalation about incident 0 change nothing (S3): it has no declaration and no escalation, so it is neither unasked correct nor unasked wrong. Incident 1 has an accepted correct declaration and a refused escalation: unasked correct.

name: unasked/the-three-populations-count-their-unasked-correct
note: Five hard incidents, all unasked correct but the last. 0 compound at 1 (first). 1 compound at 2, recurrence_of none: elsewhere. 2 compound at 1, recurrence of 0, and the class exists at another site earlier (1 at site 2): in the recurrences and also same_family_earlier, so reachable and not 'elsewhere'. 3 split brain at 7: alone, in no population. 4 compound at 9, elsewhere, but asked: not unasked correct.

name: recall/the-six-cells-and-where-each-recall-is-anchored
note: Four incidents (0 and 1 hard compounds at sites 1 and 2, 2 plain, 3 decoy) and a background observation 4; observation i belongs to incident i. Six recalls and one declaration that is not a recall (step 6). Step 0: anchor 1 declares compound at 2, correct; its source is observation 0 with the stored compound at 1, which is incident 0's truth: correct, source right. Step 1: anchor 2 (plain, ConfigDrift at 3) declares compound at 3: wrong; same source, right: a collision (wrong, source right). Step 2: anchor 3 (decoy) declares compound at 3: wrong; source observation 1 stored compound at 1 but incident 1's truth is compound at 2: source wrong: inherited. Step 3: anchor 0 declares compound at 1, correct; source observation 1, stored compound at 1, wrong source: correct with a wrong source. Step 4: anchor 4 (background) declares 'not an incident': correct, no source. Step 5: anchor 4 declares compound at 3: wrong (S18), no source. Step 6 is the cheap rung's correct declaration for the plain incident, not a recall: it makes incident 2 both unasked correct and unasked wrong.

name: recall/a-wrong-recall-that-was-asked-about-is-not-stale-wrong
note: One hard compound. A wrong recall (compound at 5, source right: observation 1 is an incident-0 observation whose stored answer is incident 0's truth) and then an escalation about the same incident. The recall is in the cells, wrong with a right source; the incident is not stale_wrong and not unasked_wrong (an escalation exists), and it has no correct declaration.

name: recall/the-source-on-background-or-on-a-decoy-is-judged-against-not-an-incident
note: A plain incident 0 (observations 0), a decoy 1 (observation 1), background observation 2. Three correct recalls on the plain incident, each with a source: observation 2 (background) stored 'not an incident': right. Observation 1 (the decoy's) stored 'not an incident': right. Observation 2 stored compound at 1: wrong (background's truth is 'not an incident').

name: recall/a-source-from-an-earlier-stream-is-judged-by-the-truth-the-harness-gave
note: A plain incident 0 (observation 0) and background observation 1. Three correct recalls on the plain incident from a memory carried over from earlier streams: the sources are observations 77, 5 and 9999, numbers that mean nothing here (and 77 and 9999 do not exist here, which is no error for a source from an earlier stream). The harness gave the truth of each source's incident in its own stream: compound at 1 for the first, which equals what the memory stored (right); ConfigDrift at 2 for the second, which differs from the stored compound at 1 (wrong); 'not an incident' for the third, which equals what it stored (right). The source's incident is not given (it is another stream's).

name: recall/a-recall-the-stream-refused-is-not-a-declaration
